versions.changelog:
Initial release of ym-training-courseware — an HTML training courseware generator for corporate instructors.

- Generates courseware with chapter navigation and in-class quiz pages, following a structured template.
- Input: a course design table specifying topics, audience, duration, and knowledge points.
- Output: Single local HTML file (`courseware.html`) with navigable chapters, per-page content, and quiz/answer pages.
- Ensures adult learning rhythm: one interactive element every 8–10 minutes.
- Suitable for both live projection and self-learning; no dependency on online services or additional software.
- Strictly formats knowledge points as provided, does not generate extra factual teaching content.
